notes.title: Welcome! 🌽
notes.notes:
[h1][b]Hello Gardeners! 🌱[/b][/h1]

[h3]We are happy to welcome you to the world of [b]Market Gardener[/b], where passion for growing plants is combined with exciting trade! 🥕🍅[/h3]

[previewyoutube=XVQlflHCl88;full][/previewyoutube]
Our game is still in the early stages of development, so we're counting on your help to make the gameplay even better! 💪 We plan to publish regular devlogs where we will introduce new mechanics and other interesting features. We'd love to hear your feedback on them, and if you have specific requests for future devlogs and game content, let us know and we'll try to accommodate them! 👍

Do you want to have an impact on the game? Join our Discord, get a special role and share your ideas for game development! 👇

[url=https://discord.gg/h72VjxAW8j][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45183157/b166ddf6293bdea5b9c048f40535da696cab0414.png[/img][/url]

[b]What are the main goals in the game? 📝[/b]
Market Gardener is all about growing plants and managing your own farm. Plant a variety of plants, take care of them, harvest and sell them at the markets to earn money and develop your farm! 💰

Each plant has its own requirements, so plan carefully to get the best harvest. 🌻 Use the funds you earn to improve your tools and take care of the quality of your farmland.


We are confident that together with you we will create a game that is rewarding and full of fun. If you want to take an active part in the development process, add Market Gardener to your wish list to receive notifications of news!

See you on the farm!
Market Gardener Team
